description: Port-only: an agent without a runtime runs the ports' runtime-less stages (TS's agent always has its default JavaScript runtime). Pins each stage's first request in full, as the TS goldens agent-first-requests-* pin the RLM stages', so all five ports send the same runtime-less prompts.
